verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Patents page says it has handled more than 60 patent trials and more than 155 inter partes review proceedings in five years, which establishes active patent litigation and names a venue type (IPR). The Trademark, Copyright & Media page claims the team led three of IPLaw360's Top 10 copyright cases of the decade, further evidence of contentious IP work. Missing for 10: named courts or specific venues, concrete case outcomes or wins, any evidence of trademark or trade-secret litigation (trademark evidence covers portfolio management only), and independent corroboration.
